name: Alexandrea Alaric
source: Alexandrea Alaric is one of the three moth leaders in Wandering Relics: Rites of the Wandering Soul. Representing light, the sky, and radiation regulation, his intense atmosphere can cause blindness to others. He plays a key role in the story alongside Atlas and Valerius.
